content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-47. - Verdict and sentence.
content.summary:
Upon the jury returning its verdict of guilty, the judge of the municipal court shall
               record the same and shall proceed to fix or determine the punishment or penalty and
               render judgment upon such verdict for the punishment or penalty so determined by him.
              …

faqs.a:
Upon the jury returning its verdict of guilty, the judge of the municipal court shall
               record the same and shall proceed to fix or determine the punishment or penalty and
               render judgment upon such verdict for the punishment or penalty so determined by him.
               But if the jury returns a verdict of not guilty, the judge shall record the same and
               shall discharge the defendant.
(Code 1960, § 1-14; Code 1981, § 18-35)
